register.reg_long_name: Nested Virtual Extended Hypervisor Configuration Register
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_NV3 is implemented, FEAT_SRMASK2 is implemented, and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Provides storage for a virtual view of HCRX_EL2 under nested virtualization.

field_description.para: Storage for the virtual view of HCRX_EL2.FNB under nested virtualization.

field_access_level.field_access_sublevel: FEAT_SRMASK2 is implemented

EL3 is not implemented or SCR2_EL3.SRMASK2En == '1'
NVHCRXMASK_EL2.FNB == '1'
